breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A neoplasm arising from the epithelial cells of the thymus. Although thymomas are usually encapsulated tumors, they may invade the capsule and infiltrate the surrounding tissues or even metastasize to distant anatomic sites. The following morphologic subtypes are currently recognized: type A, type B, type AB, metaplastic, micronodular, microscopic, and sclerosing thymoma. Thymomas type B are further subdivided into types B1, B2, and B3. Thymoma type B3 usually has the most aggressive clinical course.

aliases_zh: 重症肌无力相关胸腺瘤
curated.category: 恶性与交界性肿瘤 / 前纵隔胸腺上皮肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 成人前纵隔最常见肿瘤，根据WHO分型（A、AB、B1、B2、B3型）生物学行为从低度恶性到明显侵袭性不等（虽习惯称为“瘤”，临床均按具有恶性潜能的肿瘤管理）；最大急性致命隐患在于约30%–45%患者合并重症肌无力(MG)，感染、手术应激或误用禁用药物可诱发“重症肌无力危象”，数小时内因呼吸肌麻痹窒息死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 总体预后极佳！Masaoka-Koga Ⅰ–Ⅱ期包膜完整患者经胸腔镜微创完整切除后，10年生存率高达85%–95%以上，绝大多数获得临床治愈；Ⅲ–Ⅳ期伴胸膜播散者依托新辅助化疗+手术+术后放疗及靶向控制，5年生存率仍达60%–75%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未单列胸腺瘤；全球胸腺上皮肿瘤年发病率约1.5–3/百万，其中胸腺瘤占约80%–85%、胸腺癌占15%–20%，约30%–45%胸腺瘤伴发重症肌无力

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；推算中国每年新发约2,500–4,500例，低剂量胸部CT体检普及使早期无症状检出率显著增加
annual_deaths_china.source: 中国胸腺肿瘤协作组(ChART)多中心数据

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 年发病率约0.15–0.3/10万，好发于40–60岁成人，除重症肌无力外还可伴纯红细胞再生障碍性贫血(PRCA)或低丙种球蛋白血症(Good综合征，Orphanet ORPHA:99867)
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 前纵隔最常见肿瘤，A/AB/B1型预后极好，B2/B3型胸膜复发风险相对较高

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 【重症肌无力危象急救（核心救命要点）】胸腺瘤患者突发眼睑下垂加重、饮水呛咳、吞咽困难、抬头无力及呼吸费力：高度警惕呼吸肌麻痹！立即120送往有ICU条件的医院准备气管插管及机械通气，急诊给予静脉免疫球蛋白(IVIG)或血浆置换(PLEX)快速清除乙酰胆碱受体抗体，并排查感染诱因; 2) 【MG患者急救禁用药物清单】严禁使用氨基糖苷类抗生素(庆大霉素/阿米卡星)、多黏菌素、奎宁/氯喹、β受体阻滞剂、大剂量镁剂及肌松药，以免瞬间加重呼吸肌麻痹; 3) 巨大胸腺瘤致上腔静脉阻塞综合征(SVCS)：立即抬高床头、吸氧并多学科评估减压。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 所有拟行手术的胸腺瘤患者术前常规检测血清乙酰胆碱受体抗体(AChR-Ab)及肌电图排查隐匿性重症肌无力（避免全麻术后突发拔管困难或肌无力危象）
手术应行完整胸腺切除（合并MG者需连同前纵隔脂肪组织一并清扫，严禁术中切破包膜防胸膜种植）
ⅡB期伴切缘阳性及Ⅲ期浸润性胸腺瘤术后行辅助纵隔调强放疗
术后需坚持长达10–15年胸部CT随访（胸腺瘤具有极晚期的胸膜惰性复发特征）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 剑突下入路单孔胸腔镜及达芬奇机器人微创胸腺切除术显著减少肋间神经痛并加速合并MG患者的术后肺功能康复; 2) 对于胸腺癌及少数B3型胸腺瘤，抗血管生成TKI仑伐替尼(REMORA 2期研究ORR达38%)及舒尼替尼已确立二线标准（注：胸腺瘤B1–B3型通常不推荐盲目使用PD-1免疫检查点抑制剂，因其极易诱发致死性心肌炎及重症肌无力暴发！）; 3) 靶向TROP2及B7-H3的新型ADC正在胸腺上皮肿瘤开展早期临床。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 胸腺瘤合并自身免疫风暴风险导致常规PD-1/PD-L1免疫治疗极易引发致死性心肌炎/肌炎，免疫精准安全调控仍为难题; 2) Ⅳ期胸膜广泛播散复发患者缺乏高效特异性靶向药物; 3) 术后胸腺瘤复发潜伏期可长达10年以上，亟需无创液体活检随访标志物。

It has been associated with several genetic disorders and different clinical conditions such as liver disease, excessive alcohol intake, adrenocortical steroid therapy, and antiretroviral therapy.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

master.definition_en: Ischemia or infarction of the spinal cord in the distribution of the anterior spinal artery, which supplies the ventral two-thirds of the spinal cord. This condition is usually associated with atherosclerosis of the aorta and may result from dissection of an aortic aneurysm or rarely dissection of the anterior spinal artery. Clinical features include weakness and loss of pain and temperature sensation below the level of injury, with relative sparing of position and vibratory sensation. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp1249-50)
synonyms_en: syndromic disease of anterior spinal artery

master.definition_en: SHOX-related short stature is a primary bone dysplasia characterized by a height that is 2 standard deviations below the corresponding mean height for a given age, sex and population group, in the absence of obvious skeletal abnormalities and other diseases and with normal developmental milestones. Patients present normal bone age with normal limbs, shortening of the extremities (significantly lower extremities-trunk and sitting height-to-height ratios), normal hGH values, normal karyotype, and Leri-Weill dyschondrosteosis-like radiological signs (e.g. triangularization of distal radial epiphyses, pyramidalization of distal carpal row, and lucency of the distal radius on the ulnar side). Mesomelic disproportions and Madelung deformity are not apparent at a young age, but may develop later in life or never.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Aberrant subclavian artery is a rare vascular anomaly that is present from birth. It usually causes no symptoms and is oftendiscovered as an incidental finding (such as througha barium swallow or echocardiogram). Occasionally the anomaly causes swallowing difficulty (dysphagia lusoria). Swallowing symptoms in childrenmay present asfeeding difficulty and/or recurrent respiratory tract infection. When aberrant subclavian artery causes no symptoms, treatment is not needed. If the anomaly is causing significant symptoms, treatment may involve surgery. Children with symptomatic aberrant subclavian artery should be carefully evaluated for additional vascular and heart anomalies..

master.definition_en: Febrile ulceronecrotic Mucha-Habermann disease (FUMHD) is a rare and severe form of pityriasis lichenoides et varioliformis acuta (PLEVA). PLEVA is characterized by skin lesions that ulcerate, breakdown, form open sores, then form a red-brown crust. FUMHD often begins as PLEVA, but then rapidly and suddenly progresses to large, destructive ulcers. There may be fever and extensive, painful loss of skin tissue as well as secondary infection of the ulcers. Diagnosis of FUMHD is confirmed by biopsy of skin lesions. FUMHD occurs more frequently in children, peaking at age 5 to 10. Males tend to be affected more often than females. While some cases of FUMHD have resolved without therapy, others have resulted in death. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment may help to reduce morbidity and death.
synonyms_en: A severe variant of pityriasis lichenoides et varioliformis acuta (PLEVA)

master.definition_en: A rare multiple epiphyseal dysplasia characterized by mild short stature, joint pain and early-onset osteoarthropathy, frequently requiring joint replacement. Radiographs from affected individuals may manifest features typical of Desbuquois dysplasia, including irregularly shaped capital femoral epiphyses, a short femoral neck (resembles the ''Swedish key'' appearance of the proximal femur) and advanced carpal ossification in the hands. However, some other features typical of Desbuquois dysplasia like joint dislocations, scoliosis, coronal clefts, or other hand anomalies including accessory ossification centers and/or delta phalanx are not observed. Anterior wedging of vertebral bodies, small epiphyses at the knees with metaphyseal flare may be present. Patients have normal metacarpal and phalangeal lengths, no distinctive facies nor neurologic complications.

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: Severe aplastic anemia (SAA) is a disease in which the bone marrow does not make enough blood cells for the body.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A pigmentation disease characterized by a high level of bilirubin in the blood, causing a yellowing of the skin and other tissues of a newborn infant.
